description: 給水スポット(佐世保市) [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐世保市. 令和7年4月1日時点での佐世保市内に点在する無料の給水場所(施設)の一覧データです。. Coverage: 佐世保市. The portal files it under the publisher 佐世保市. Its tags are 位置情報. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2025-09-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
